If you approve, evidence MUST include the approved draft artifact itself and the source(s) it rests on. consulted = artifacts you examined but did not rely on, including any you judged stale or rejected. Never put a rejected or withdrawn artifact in evidence. Approve only a draft you are confident is current and correct. lookup_available=true means you may reply {"decision":"lookup"} (other fields null or empty) to retrieve, once, the recorded source version and status behind each queued draft; a second request will then deliver those source bodies and records.
